title: Two utilities docs pages hardcode "Version: 0.3.1" in their Package Information block while both packages are at 17.4.0
body:
Out-of-scope finding from #3781 (dependency-contract prose on one of these pages).

## Fact (verified on `origin/main` = `cfeb378b5`)

| Doc site | Claim | Manifest |
|---|---|---|
| `content/docs/utilities/data-objectstack.mdx:451` | `**Version:** 0.3.1` | `packages/data-objectstack/package.json` = `17.4.0` |
| `content/docs/utilities/vscode-extension.mdx:418` | `**Version:** 0.3.1` | `packages/vscode-extension/package.json` = `17.4.0` |

Those are the only two `**Version:**` lines under `content/docs/` (`grep -rn '\*\*Version:\*\*' content/docs/`), and both are wrong by the same stale value, which suggests one copied template rather than two independent drifts.

## Why this is a `finding` and not a queued defect

Nothing enforces or reads these lines, and no user action depends on them the way an install command does — a reader who pins `@object-ui/data-objectstack@0.3.1` on this basis gets a version that does not exist, so it is not zero-impact, but it is drift rather than a live breakage. Grading is the triage round's call.

## Fix direction (not pre-judged)

Two shapes, and the choice matters more than the edit:

- **Remove the version line from both pages.** A hardcoded version in prose re-drifts on the next release by construction; the packages ship 39-at-a-time from a fixed group, so the number carries no page-specific information anyway. This is the low-maintenance direction.
- **Generate it.** Keep the line but source it from the manifest at build time, so it cannot drift again.

Nothing in the repo currently checks docs prose against manifest versions, so whichever way it goes, the second occurrence is evidence the manual form does not hold.

## Searched for duplicates

`docs version stale utilities package information` and `data-objectstack docs API reference` over open issues in this repo: zero relevant hits.
